name: Exogenous action set

subjectOf.text: The Human-Derived Coordination Architecture implements only the consumption side of the computative labor market: job specifications, expertise taxonomies, and contract templates are exogenous parameters set by clients or governance, so the generation side is absent from the protocol.
subjectOf.abstract: HDCA implements the consumption side of the computative labor market and does not implement the generation side. Job specifications, expertise taxonomies, and contract templates are exogenous parameters set by clients or by governance.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Possibility Loops An Operational Architecture for Computative Economics in Agent Coordination Systems (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6655138
scope_conditions: current agent coordination protocols inherited from human freelance markets

subjectOf.text: Limitation L1, HDCA exhaustion: any agent coordination architecture in which the action set is exogenous to agent action implements at most a reputation-weighted Neoclassical labor market and does not implement Computative Economics.
subjectOf.abstract: Limitation L1 (HDCA exhaustion). Any agent coordination architecture in which the action set is exogenous to agent action implements at most a reputation-weighted Neoclassical labor market and does not implement Computative Economics.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Possibility Loops An Operational Architecture for Computative Economics in Agent Coordination Systems (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6655138
scope_conditions: any agent coordination architecture with an exogenous action set
